verdict.rationale: Bento is an agent observability and evaluation platform, so custom scorers are a fair question to ask of it. The evidence, however, only shows scoring and detection defined in plain English: signals are trained from natural-language descriptions, and releases are scored against production history. Nothing documents a way to write custom code-based scorers or metric functions. Natural-language signals and built-in metrics are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, I can write custom code-based scorers and metrics for my evaluations
